about_the_game:
Download now and receive the exclusive Frameblade knife skin. Redeemable code available after character creation.

Play the full Dune: Awakening character creator and build a unique persona that can be saved and imported into the full game at launch on April 29. Then test your hardware with the benchmark mode, featuring epic scenes from the deserts of Arrakis, where the sandworms roam.

Character Creation

Put your hand in the box.

Create your character by enduring the Reverend Mother’s test of the Gom Jabbar. Determine every aspect of your appearance, then select your home planet, caste, and finally, your mentor.

The final choice, whether it be Swordmaster, Bene Gesserit, Mentat, or Trooper, determines your starting abilities, but does not lock you into a path, as you will eventually unlock all of them. Even active abilities can be a mix from any Schools.

When Dune: Awakening launches on April 29, you will be able to import your character into the full game.

Benchmark Sequence

Launch the benchmark to test your PC performance, and adjust your graphics settings to find the optimal balance for you. The fly-through sequence takes you from a player-built base in the desert to Harko Village, the brooding, bustling Harkonnen player hub, finally concluding with a close encounter with a colossal sandworm.

About Dune: Awakening

Rise from survival to greatness and challenge the power of an Imperium in Dune: Awakening, a multiplayer survival game on a massive scale. Survive the sandworm, craft your ornithopter, build a fortress, and ascend to power on an open world Arrakis shared with hundreds of other players.
